dialogue.origin: こんにちは13時からですので、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello. Our session starts at 1:00 p.m., so I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you, I look forward to it.

dialogue.origin: 時間になりましたので、始めます
dialogue.content: It's time, so let's begin.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: 始めに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: ４０歳女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a 40-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 姑と舅の私への監視、監督？がひどくて困ってます
dialogue.content: I'm having a hard time because my mother-in-law and father-in-law's constant monitoring, or supervision I guess, of me is terrible.

dialogue.origin: 監視ですか・・・それは嫌ですよね
dialogue.content: Monitoring... That must be very unpleasant.

dialogue.origin: はい、凄くいやです
dialogue.content: Yes, it's awful.

dialogue.origin: どんなことを監視や監督されるのですか？
dialogue.content: In what ways do they monitor or try to supervise you?

dialogue.origin: 何時に何処へ何をしてきたのか行くときも玄関へお見送り。帰ったらねほりはほり。
dialogue.content: When I leave, they see me off at the door, and when I get back, they interrogate me about what time I left, where I went, and what I did.

dialogue.origin: カレンダーに仕事の日を書かされます
dialogue.content: They make me write my work days on the calendar.

dialogue.origin: なるほどあなたの行動を細かいことまで知りたがるのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So they want to know every little detail about your activities.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: それでは息が詰ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: That must feel suffocating.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: さしつかえなかったら、あなたの家族構成を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: If you don't mind my asking, could you tell me about your family household?

dialogue.origin: 主人の両親、主人と子が一人、五人家族です。
dialogue.content: It's my husband's parents, my husband, our one child, and myself. A family of five.

dialogue.origin: 一階に主人の親、二階に私たち三人の
dialogue.content: My husband's parents are on the first floor, and the three of us are on the second.

dialogue.origin: 完全二世帯での形です
dialogue.content: It's a two-family home arrangement.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんのご両親と同居されているんですね
dialogue.content: So you're living with your husband's parents.

dialogue.origin: はい、玄関は一つで、キッチンもお風呂も食事も別々です
dialogue.content: Yes, we share one main entrance, but our kitchens, bathrooms, and meals are all separate.

dialogue.origin: 玄関が一つだと、外出とか行動が解ってしまいそうですね
dialogue.content: With only one entrance, it would be easy for them to notice your comings and goings.

dialogue.origin: はい。分からないように出ていったら、帰ったら何で声かけなかった？頼みたかったのにとか、電話がかかる事もあり、
dialogue.content: Yes. If I try to leave without them knowing, when I get back they'll ask, 'Why didn't you let us know? I wanted to ask you to do something,' and sometimes they even call me.

dialogue.origin: 出ていくときに色々服装とか、荷物とか、言葉とかチェックが多くて困ります
dialogue.content: It's difficult, too, because when I'm leaving, they check so many things—my clothes, what I'm carrying, and what I say—which is really troubling.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですかそれでは、外出するのもおっくうになりそうですね
dialogue.content: I see. That would make you reluctant to even go out, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい。外出が億劫になって
dialogue.content: Yes, I've become reluctant to go out.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I can imagine.

dialogue.origin: 静かに二階で過ごしてると必ず声がかかります
dialogue.content: If I'm just spending time quietly upstairs, they always call out to me.

dialogue.origin: ところで、甥の方も監視されるとのことですが、よくこられるのですか？
dialogue.content: By the way, you mentioned your nephew also monitors you. Does he visit often?

dialogue.origin: 行き違って済みません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I misunderstood.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、しゅうとです
dialogue.content: No, no, it's my father-in-law.

dialogue.origin: 字を読み違ってしまいました失礼しました
dialogue.content: I misread the character; my apologies.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ
dialogue.content: No problem.

dialogue.origin: 家に居るときも気が休まりませんね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you can't relax even when you're at home.

dialogue.origin: はい。静かにしていると、風邪でも引いたの？体調悪いの？と言ってお茶しようと・・それがまたしんどい。
dialogue.content: That's right. If I'm being quiet, they'll say, 'Did you catch a cold? Are you feeling unwell?' and then suggest we have tea... and that's just exhausting.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 両方共に私を追いかけて話してきます
dialogue.content: Both of them follow me around and talk to me.

dialogue.origin: しょっちゅう付き合っていなくてはならないんですね本当に気が休まらないことと思います
dialogue.content: So you constantly have to engage with them. I imagine you can never truly relax.

dialogue.origin: あなたのお気持ちは夫さんにはお話されていますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to your husband about how you feel?

dialogue.origin: はい。休まらないです神経も。
dialogue.content: Yes. I can't relax, and my nerves are frayed.

dialogue.origin: 勿論主人に話します
dialogue.content: Of course, I talk to my husband.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんは、どんな風に言いますか？
dialogue.content: What does your husband say about it?

dialogue.origin: アホは相手にするな、ほっとけ、でいつも終わります。
dialogue.content: It always ends with him saying, “Don’t bother with idiots—just ignore them.”

dialogue.origin: 姑の口も手も出てとにかく凄いので
dialogue.content: Because my mother-in-law is just so overbearing with her words and actions.

dialogue.origin: うーんほっとけと言われても向こうから追っかけてこられてはね
dialogue.content: Hmm... it's difficult to just ignore them when they are the ones pursuing you.

dialogue.origin: え？？？手もでるんですか？
dialogue.content: Wait... she gets physical?

dialogue.origin: それは酷いですね
dialogue.content: That's terrible.

dialogue.origin: 手が出るとは、育児を取ってしまう感じ。私のすることをいちいち判定して、提案して、自分でやってしまう。主人はどちらかと言えば、押されて何も言わない人に・・
dialogue.content: By 'gets physical,' I mean she takes over the childcare. She judges everything I do, makes her own suggestions, and then just does it herself. My husband is the type who, if anything, gets steamrolled and doesn't say a word.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私は新米ママだから我慢してやってねと孫に言ったり
dialogue.content: She would say to my grandchild things like, 'Your mom is new at this, so you'll have to be patient with her.'

dialogue.origin: 姑さんがそう言われるのですか？
dialogue.content: Your mother-in-law would say that?

dialogue.origin: ↑子供が小さいころの話ですが、そう言って抱くのを奪い取られた事何度も。
dialogue.content: This was when my child was little, but she would say that and snatch him from my arms many times.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですか
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: そのときどんな風に思いましたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel at those times?

dialogue.origin: 冗談じゃないと思いました。私は育児が大変って思ったことないのに。姑に私は恵まれてると・・面倒見てくれる自分って存在が居る事感謝しろみたいに。
dialogue.content: I thought, 'You have to be kidding.' I never felt that raising my child was a burden. But my mother-in-law acts as if I'm so fortunate... like I should be grateful to have her around to 'help.'

dialogue.origin: 頼んでもないのに恩着せがましく言われたら腹が立ちますよね
dialogue.content: It’s infuriating to have someone act like they’re doing you a favor when you never asked for it.

dialogue.origin: ところで、あなたは外でお仕事とかはされていますか？
dialogue.content: By the way, do you work outside the home?

dialogue.origin: はい、子供が三歳になるまでは働くなと言われ、三歳になったら今度は外で仕事しろと
dialogue.content: Yes. I was told not to work until my child was three, and then once my child turned three, I was told to get a job outside the home.

dialogue.origin: 仕事先まであれこれ口だしがありました
dialogue.content: They even meddled in my choice of workplace.

dialogue.origin: 仕事先というか就職内容ですね
dialogue.content: Or rather, the type of job.

dialogue.origin: そこまで介入してくるんですか・・・
dialogue.content: They interfere to that extent...?

dialogue.origin: はい、全てに、です
dialogue.content: Yes—in everything.

dialogue.origin: 支配されているようで、本当にしんどいと思います
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're being controlled. I imagine that's truly exhausting.

dialogue.origin: はい、支配されてるようです。ご近所の人付き合いは苦手みたいで私に振ってきます。
dialogue.content: Yes, it feels like I’m being controlled. They seem to be poor at interacting with neighbors, so they push that responsibility onto me.

dialogue.origin: そこまで追い詰められているあなたのお気持ちをご主人は十分に理解されていないように思うのですが？
dialogue.content: I get the sense your husband may not fully understand how cornered you feel—would you agree?

dialogue.origin: はい。そこですよね。主人は無視してこれまで来たから、これからも無視し続けるみたいに言います
dialogue.content: Yes, that's the point. My husband says he's always just ignored them, so he'll continue to do so.

dialogue.origin: 主人が何も言わず怒ってるので姑も、息子は私に何で怒ってるの？と・・・
dialogue.content: Since my husband is silently angry, my mother-in-law asks me, "Why is my son mad at me?"

dialogue.origin: 間に挟まる事で関係が保ってるような、主人の策略なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It feels like the relationship is maintained by me being in the middle; is that my husband's strategy?

dialogue.origin: 確認ですが、何もいわない主人さんに対して姑さんも怒っているということですよね？
dialogue.content: Just to clarify, are you saying your mother-in-law is also angry with your husband for his silence?

dialogue.origin: 怒ってる？とゆう感じはないですね。息子は(姑)自分を無視するので、悲しいって感じ。私から何とか言ってくれって感じです。
dialogue.content: Angry? Not really. It's more that she feels sad because her son is ignoring her. She wants me to say something to him on her behalf.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 主人が無言の威圧を母親にしてるので。
dialogue.content: Because my husband is giving his mother the silent treatment as a form of pressure.

dialogue.origin: そういうことでしたか
dialogue.content: Ah, so that's what's happening.

dialogue.origin: 母親はさっぱり、息子が何を考えてるのか分からないまま。
dialogue.content: The mother really has no idea what her son is thinking.

dialogue.origin: 中々もどかしい状況ですね
dialogue.content: That sounds like a very frustrating situation.

dialogue.origin: これまでのお話を整理させていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: May I summarize what you've shared so far?

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 最長14:10で終了お願い致します。
dialogue.content: Please finish by 2:10 p.m. at the latest.

dialogue.origin: あなたは同居している姑と舅に年中監視・監督されて息が詰るような暮らしをされてきた。
dialogue.content: You've been living in a suffocating environment, constantly monitored and supervised by your mother-in-law and father-in-law who live with you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 外出時も詳しいことを聞かれたり、服装までチェックされたりするし、
dialogue.content: When you go out, they ask for detailed questions and even check your clothing,

dialogue.origin: 家にいるときも、しょっちゅう付き合わされて気が休まるときもないし、
dialogue.content: and even when you're at home, you are constantly forced to engage with them and never have a moment to relax,

dialogue.origin: 子育てや仕事の事にまでもいちいち介入してきた
dialogue.content: and they have interfered in every aspect of your life, including your parenting and your job.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 主人さんにあなたの気持ちを話しても、ほっとけと言われるし
dialogue.content: Even when you share your feelings with your husband, he just tells you to ignore them,

dialogue.origin: 無言の圧力をかけてくれても、拉致があかない
dialogue.content: and while he gives them the silent treatment, the situation doesn't improve.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is that an accurate summary?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's correct.

dialogue.origin: 時間になりました。
dialogue.content: Our time is up.

dialogue.origin: 聞いていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.origin: 今日は解決策まで至らずに申し訳ありませんでしたが、
dialogue.content: I'm sorry we couldn't get to a solution today,

dialogue.origin: ご相談の内容は残りますので、よかったらまたお話にきてください
dialogue.content: but we have a record of our conversation, so please feel free to come back and talk more if you'd like.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。終了でお願いします。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much. Let's end the session here. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: 本日は相談にきていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in to talk today.

dialogue.origin: これで終了とさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: This concludes our session.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

topic.sub: 姑との過干渉と監視問題
